child.label: Describing Character
child.description: Questions asking how you would describe a person in a short everyday scene: their traits or what kind of person they are, judged from what they did.
child.not_for: Questions asking how the person or others would feel afterwards or as a result (use Feelings After Events). Why they acted or what happens next (use Reading Motives & Plans).
examples: How would you describe Cameron? (Cameron returned shoes he couldn't afford.)
How would you describe Casey as a person?
How would you describe Jan? (Jan bought a car after saving for months.)

child.label: Feelings After Events
child.description: Questions asking how a person, or others around them, would feel afterwards or as a result of what happened in a short everyday scene.
child.not_for: Questions asking how you would describe the person or their character (use Describing Character). Why they acted or what happens next (use Reading Motives & Plans).
examples: How would Jesse feel afterwards? (Jesse burned a fancy meal.)
How would others feel as a result?
How would Robin feel afterwards? (Robin spent the night in jail.)
